## Man City Starting XI vs Ipswich Town: Confirmed Team News and Predicted Lineup

### Man City Predicted XI vs Ipswich as Enzo Maresca Weighs Erling Haaland Rest [...] Behind him, changes look more realistic. Rayan Cherki was hooked at half-time in Paris and that usually tells its own story. Phil Foden is available again after a three-match suspension and should come straight back into the side. Iliman Ndiaye also made an impact off the bench and offers directness that City lacked for stretches in midweek.

### Rotation expected across defence and midfield [...] There are no fresh injuries, which gives Maresca room to shuffle without excuses. Ayyoub Bouaddi did well after coming on against PSG and looks ready for a start, with Elliot Anderson a candidate for a breather. Matheus Nunes should return at right-back after Abdukodir Khusanov endured a rough night against Desire Doue.

### Juventude's Predicted Lineup [...] For this match, the coach will have just one confirmed absentee to contend with: center-back Luiz Otávio is serving an automatic suspension and will be missing from the defense. As a result, the coaching staff has adjusted the team to maintain its solidity and improve its attacking creativity, relying on the movement of players such as Zanocelo, Matheus Araújo, and Renzo López leading the attack.
